title: Matter-wave Induced Transparency
summary: Electromagnetically induced transparency suppresses optical absorption through destructive interference, playing a central role in light-matter interaction and quantum information science. We report matter-wave induced transparency, where atomic collisional interactions induce transmission through a lossy molecular potential for the incident atomic scattering waves. Using cesium Bose-Einstein condensates and modulation-induced Feshbach resonances, we realize a three-level atom-molecule coupled system with unprecedented flexibility.
